title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Rate Schedule Credited on a Payer Conversion
content:
**Finance office clarification, conversions — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** The conversion credit schedule — which private pay schedule's rate the conversion credit gives back — follows how the charge was priced.

| Charge | Conversion credit schedule |
|---|---|
| Standard charge basis, posted on or after 1 July 2026 (the current schedule's effective date) | The current private pay schedule |
| Prior-rate notice-hold charge basis | The preceding schedule |
| Any other charge | The schedule in effect for the agreement on the first day of the charge's span: current once the rate notice had run its 60 days by that day and the span begins on or after 1 July 2026, preceding otherwise |

| Accommodation tier | Preceding schedule (effective 1 July 2025), USD per day | Current schedule (effective 1 July 2026), USD per day |
|---|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 384.00 | 398.00 |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 412.00 | 427.00 |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 421.00 | 436.00 |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 449.00 | 465.00 |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 466.00 | 482.00 |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 497.00 | 514.00 |

**Points of judgement (hypothetical).** A first-month partial charge whose span begins after 1 July 2026, notice delivered 90 days before the span: current. The same with notice delivered 20 days before the span: preceding.
